definitions.explanation: a learned ability or expertise, especially in professional or practical contexts

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいスキルを{身|み}につけたい。
examples.english: I want to acquire new skills.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}には{高|たか}いコミュニケーションスキルが{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: This job requires high communication skills.

notes:
USAGE:
スキル is commonly used in business and professional contexts. It often appears in compound forms.

COMPOUNDS:
- コミュニケーションスキル - communication skills
- ビジネススキル - business skills
- ITスキル - IT skills
- ソフトスキル - soft skills (interpersonal)
- ハードスキル - hard skills (technical)
- スキルアップ - skill improvement
- スキルセット - skill set

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スキルを{磨|みが}く - to polish/hone skills
- スキルを{身|み}につける - to acquire skills
- スキルを{活|い}かす - to utilize skills
- スキル{不足|ぶそく} - lack of skills
